title: Shoko Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for Shoko plugin manifest files (manifest.json). Defines the plugin package metadata and its releases, with their dependencies.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (optional, for IDE validation).

id.description: Unique package identifier (UUID v4). Must match the Plugin.ID in the C# code.

type.description: Manifest type. A 'package' is a full plugin definition. A 'manifest' is a reference to another manifest URL.

url.description: Referenced manifest location. Required when type is 'manifest'. Must be an absolute http://, https:// or ftp:// URL.

overview.description: Describes what the package does at a high level.

namespace.description: Optional short, unique name the plugin reserves for itself, which other plugins and conventions may key off. Kebab-case, 2 to 32 characters; 'shoko', 'core' and 'plugin' are reserved. Two loaded plugins claiming the same one keep the server from starting.

authors.description: The author(s) of the package and plugin releases contained within it.

repository_url.description: The repository URL for the package, if provided.

homepage_url.description: The home-page URL for the package, if provided.

image_url.description: Deprecated: use thumbnail_url for the wide image, icon_url for the square one, or both. One field could not say which of the two it was, so it was read as a thumbnail while authors supplied logos to it. Still honoured as a fallback for thumbnail_url, so an existing manifest keeps working unchanged.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional wide image URL, shown where there is room for one. Takes precedence over image_url.

icon_url.description: Optional square image URL, shown beside the plugin's name where there is no room for the thumbnail. Supply something that is still readable at 24 pixels; it is neither cropped nor scaled for you.

tags.description: Search tags for the plugin. Maximum of 20 tags.

is_meta.description: Whether the package is a meta plugin, one that only brings in its dependencies. Written by shoko-build from the releases: true when every release is one, false when any is not, and left out when no release says either way.

Dependency.title: Plugin Dependency
Dependency.description: A dependency on another plugin, identified by its UUID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the plugin this package depends on.

version.description: The semantic version constraint (e.g. '>=1.0.0', '^2.0.0', '~1.0.0', or an exact version like '1.5.0').

optional.description: If true, the dependency is optional. A missing optional dependency produces a warning but does not block install or enable.

Release.title: Plugin Release
Release.description: A specific versioned release of the plugin.

version.description: Shared semantic version for the release. Supports formats: '1', '1.0', '1.0.0', '1.0.0.0' for stable, or '1.0.0-dev.N' for dev. The '-dev.N' suffix is only valid when the channel is 'Dev'.

tag.description: The source revision tag of the release, if provided (e.g. 'v1.2.3').

source_revision.description: The SHA digest of the source revision used to build the release, if provided.

channel.description: The release channel. When set to 'Dev', the version may include a '-dev.N' suffix. For other channels, the version must not include a dev suffix.

release_notes.description: Release notes, or null if not available for this release.

is_meta.description: Whether the release is a meta plugin, one whose only code is its generated plugin class, so it only brings in its dependencies. Written by shoko-build from what the build detected; left out when the build did not say.

dependencies.description: The plugins this release depends on, which the server resolves when it installs the release. The build records the dependencies the project states.

archives.description: Available archives for different runtime environments and architectures.

Archive.title: Plugin Archive
Archive.description: A platform-specific binary archive for a release.

runtime.description: The .NET runtime identifier (e.g. 'any', 'linux-x64', 'win-x64', 'linux-arm64', 'osx-x64'). Use 'any' for portable builds.

abstraction.description: The Shoko.Abstractions version the plugin was built against (e.g. '6.0.0').

url.description: Direct download URL for the archive (.zip).

checksum.description: Checksum for archive verification. Either a bare hex string (backward compatible) or prefixed with 'sha256:', 'sha1:', or 'md5:'.
